There's a free plan with 3 min/month — enough to evaluate, not to produce.
Can I clone myself?
Yes on Starter and above — a short webcam recording creates your avatar.
Synthesia vs HeyGen?
Synthesia leads on enterprise features and language coverage; HeyGen on avatar realism for social content. See our AI video tools guide.
trial_checklist: Use a real task involving training videos—not a demo prompt. Verify whether 230+ ai avatars with natural gestures materially reduces editing or setup time. testing_notes: Grammarly remains the least intrusive AI assistant — it improves text where you already write rather than demanding a new app. Rewrite quality improved noticeably with the newer models. The free tier covers most grammar needs; Pro earns its price mainly through tone and rewrites.
best_plan: Free for grammar basics; Pro at $12/mo (annual billing) if you write professionally daily.
faq: Is Grammarly Pro worth it?
For daily professional writing, yes — tone control and full rewrites are the real value. Occasional writers can stay free.
Does Grammarly work in Google Docs?
Yes, fully integrated including the sidebar and generative features.
Is my text private?
Grammarly states text is not sold; Enterprise adds contractual controls. Free users' text may be processed to provide the service.
